summary.title: NORDRE HOVDESKOGEN BORETTSLAG

narrative.text: NORDRE HOVDESKOGEN BORETTSLAG is a Norwegian housing cooperative in "Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier", registered 1995-02-19.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2024 show revenue of NOK 2.8 million and an annual result of NOK 1.0 million.
Head office in Drammen, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.

revenue_comparison.derivation: absolute_change = latest_revenue - previous_revenue; percent_change = absolute_change / previous_revenue * 100 (only when previous_revenue > 0)

summary.revenue_comparison_text: Revenue was NOK 2.8 million in 2024, up from NOK 2.7 million in 2023, an increase of NOK 90,821 (3.4%).
